messages:
maria: quick q — our inference services are spiking OTLP payloads with huge KV/cache attrs. how do we want to normalize/truncate before exporting? saw a single span with ~500kb of attrs last night.

jonathan: agreed this is bad. we need both attr size caps and a dedupe policy for repeated kvcache keys. propose: per-attribute max_len=4096, max_attrs_per_span=128, and if total size > 64kb then summarize into payload summary attr.

lee: +1 on centralized policy. important: implement in an official shim so python/go/rust behave the same, not ad-hoc in each service.

anya: shim should also annotate when we truncate so downstream can ignore/alert. e.g. set redwood.telemetry.truncated=true and redwood.telemetry.truncation_reason=attr_size. privacy teams want a clear flag.

maria: sounds good. also need de-dup semantics for kvcache: if multiple entries share a prefix (kvcache.*) collapse to top-N keys and count rest. reduces cardinality.

jonathan: sampling question — token-level spans are noisy. recommend two-tier sampling: always-sample control spans (alloc/route/error), sample kvcache spans at configurable rate (default 0.01) but allow tenant-hash sticky sampling for per-tenant signal.

lee: impl sketch for python shim (will upstream to our internal pypi):
```python
from redwood_telemetry import init_inference_telemetry
init_inference_telemetry(
    service_name="inference-runtime",
    attr_max_len=4096,
    max_attrs=128,
    total_span_size_limit=65536,
    kv_dedup_prefixes=["kvcache.", "route."],
    kvcache_top_n=10,
    sample_rate_kvcache=0.01,
    otlp_endpoint=os.environ.get("OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT")
)
```

anya: exporter behaviour: batch exporter with backpressure drop policy + exponential retry, but we must flush on shutdown (blocking up to 5s). if agent unreachable >30s, switch to disk-buffered exporter and emit an event to ingest.

maria: retention metadata: add redwood.retention.tenant=<id> on spans and enforce per-tenant retention at ingest. also add redwood.privacy_masked=true when truncation removed raw keys.

jonathan: we should also normalize attribute keys: lowercase, replace whitespace with _, remove tenant-specific tokens from keys where possible to avoid explosion. log examples to allow audit.

lee: tests: unit tests for truncation, dedupe, sampling determinism (seeded), plus a quick harness that generates 10k spans and verifies exporter size limits. I'll own python tests.

anya: ownership: I'll write RFC with config knobs and a small state machine for dedupe/overflow behavior. suggest env vars: REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_ATTR_LIMIT, REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_TOTAL_SPAN_LIMIT, REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_KV_TOP_N, REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_SAMPLE_RATE_KVCACHE.

jonathan: i can take impl for go + rust wrappers. API parity required: same options, same flags, same telemetry annotation keys.

deploy-bot: deploy window scheduled: wed 03:30 UTC canary -> thursday global if no regressions.

ingest-bot: created alert rule: telemetry.attr_size > 256000 => page oncall. also added dashboard panel for attr-size distribution by service.

maria: ok next steps: anya opens RFC, lee opens python PR, jonathan opens go/rust PRs. add a small migration checklist for existing services to opt-in. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
